name: great helm
_design_note: F40-80 heavy head slot. Full-face enclosure trades vision for pierce resist. Heavier than plate_helm but no extra base AC — the tradeoff is the resist line, not the number.
lore_template: A {material_name} great helm, a flat-topped barrel that encloses the whole head and leaves only a slit for the eyes and a few holes for breath. Nothing gets in. Very little can be seen or heard from inside, either.
